title: SessionClosedEvent
description: The presence interval opened by SESSION_OPENED ended at this tick. It shares the opening event's correlation_id, which is how the pair is joined - no duplicated opening tick is stored, because a derived copy can disagree with the fact it was derived from. close_reason records WHY the session ended, which is what makes the fact worth storing: 'the actor left' and 'the server cut the actor off' are different facts.

actor_id.description: Narrowed from the envelope: never null for this type.

session_id.description: Session this event closes. Exactly one SESSION_CLOSED exists per SESSION_OPENED.

close_reason.description: CLIENT_CLOSED: the peer closed cleanly. IDLE_TIMEOUT: no pong within the liveness window. PROTOCOL_VIOLATION: the peer exceeded the violation budget. SLOW_CONSUMER: the outbound queue filled and the server dropped the connection to protect the tick loop. SERVER_SHUTDOWN: graceful shutdown. TRANSPORT_ERROR: the socket failed. Values may be ADDED in a later version; consumers must tolerate unknown values.
